name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement unambiguous state discrimination of
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement unambiguous state discrimination of |0> and |+> in Qiskit via a Naimark dilation: construct the 3-outcome POVM as a 2-qubit unitary + measurement, run 16384 shots for each input, and report the conclusive/inconclusive statistics. Return the entire program in one piece, ready to run without any modification.
